item.tib: rnam thar g.yung drung gsang ba'i mdzod chen las ma 'ongs gter gyi shis brjod smon lam le'u
item.coloph: bdag nyid spu rgyal gnas kyi lung bstan byung dus tshe lung dpal 'bar gdong du phyin zhing bsang dang tshogs mchod rgya cher 'bul(phul/)sde brgyad gser skyems lha srin dam bsgrags nan tan byas/ las ldan gyi grogs dbang gi sgrol ma dang/ skyes bu dam pa dag pa'i 'khor tshogs dang bcas te gnas tshe bum 'dra ba la phyin pas/ 'chi med rgyal ba yab sras kyi zhal dngos su mthong / gter srung yab sras sde lnga dgyes tshul gyis sdong grogs byas nas/ me tog gi char sil ma bab cing rten 'brel legs lam du gyur te bar chad med par kho bo gsang sngags gling pa yab yum gyis shing glang ston zla 'bring po'i yar tshes zab gter rin chen bton sku gsung thugs kyi rten bcas spyan drangs nas gsang rgya bsdom zhing sbas/ rab byung bcu drug bdun thog mar rab byung zhes pa me yos lo'i hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu la/ phyis su zab gter rin po che bka' rgya bkrol ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe/ khams dbus kyi grub brnyes dam pa mchog gyur rnam dag dang*/ bka' babs las can gyi skyes bu dam pa du ma dang dad slob mang pos yang yang bskul ba la brten nas/ sbas gnas shang lang brag dkar gyi nye 'dab rang bstan dbal khyung bla brang gi gdan sa ru mkha' 'gro'i brda yig ldeb lnga bzhugs pa bod yig tu phab pas dbu bzung ste/ slar yang mdo khams kyi gnas chen g.yung drung gsang ba dbal rong drag po gnam lcags yang rdzong gi thog ka'i sa'i cha/ dbra khyung sa le'i yul ljongs 'chi med byang chub gling gi sgrub sde chen po'i dben khrod/ rgya rigs khod spungs dbon sprul bstan 'dzin gyis bsti gnas zla 'od bdud rtsi'i zil pa snying la cil yang 'babs pa'i spro khang du rten 'brel gyi ngo mtshar du ma dang bcas te lcags rta lo yi nag pa zla ba'i tshes bcu'i mchod pa dang 'brel bar/ yongs su rdzogs par bod yig tu gtan la phab pa'i dge bas rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par gshen bstan gsang sems snying po'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs thams cad du sgo kun nas dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig tha tshan mu tsug smar ro//
